title: Page 179
transc:
Wash'n May 31 1864
Geo D Sheldon Ft Monroe
Imogene for pontiac officer animal unity the weaseler victor
was to leave France on the harrow plaster &
the Wayworner sentinal on the lamp for this city
zebra they have on board manifest vienna pause if
you can intercept these vessels their patent equipage will
be sent as before ordered up the Bergen Bennett
TT Eckert


Ft Monroe May 31 . 1864
Maj Eckert Di to Caldwell HdQrs Qrs A. of P.
for Shelby S Williams Assistant Beach Snake oyster Attica
zebra I have just had sent to me by
Lieutenant paradise Biggs Vincent at this upton and order
of Jacob to him that all village patenting that
arrives here shall be sent to Knox zodiac I
therefore propose when the villages arrive pedlar as is
not the case yet pekin to send some plug
prolong mansion or peach publish spit with them to
Knave and retain here the balance of the panther
with the special material trains etc for your further
orders pedlar as I presume toby what you would
desire Webster H W Benham palsy Laura very hot
Geo D Sheldon
